description: Merge encrypted sources and re-secure the result in one call (pdfnative v1.6 encrypted round-trip). merge_pdfs now ingests encrypted sources via `password` and re-encrypts the assembled document via `encrypt`. Here two password-protected PDFs (same password) are concatenated and the output is re-encrypted with a fresh AES-128 owner/user password. Signatures and AcroForms are always dropped by a page-tree edit. Replace the <base64…> placeholders with real encrypted PDF bytes.
